selectionOutcomes.description: Entry resolves the supplied share token through getActiveMemoShare and returns any lookup or expiry error.
Loads the exact MemoID carried by the resolved share, rejects missing, non-normal, or SPACE-audience memos, and requires an allowed read context.
Shows reaction and attachment failure branches, creator-not-found handling during conversion, other conversion errors, relation-graph removal, and successful return.
Looks up the supplied token and returns NOT_FOUND when it does not resolve or is expired.
Defines expiration as an ExpiresTs strictly earlier than the current Unix time.
Delegates MemoShare lookup, leaving whether the supplied token exists as a runtime store fact.
Resolves the current viewer; for an anonymous caller it also queries instance anonymous-access policy before forwarding the shared memo ID.
Rejects a nil memo and delegates read-context resolution with the viewer, anonymous-policy value, and shared memo ID.
Resolves memo facts and combines them with viewer and share-token context.
Shows structural and creator validity checks, lifecycle checks, and the exact-memo non-SPACE share override before ordinary visibility rules.
Defines an allowed read decision as one with no denial.
Defines active-viewer status; a nil anonymous viewer is not active.
Defines the administrator bypass in terms of an active viewer, which excludes an anonymous caller.
Shows how memo facts bind the memo and determine the creator-validity fact consumed by the read decision.
Shows that the supplied shared memo ID is copied into the read context together with the viewer and resolved memo facts.
Shows the early return that skips space-membership resolution for a memo without a space, an invalid space, or an inactive/anonymous viewer.
